data.narrative:
Physical Intelligence, a Series B AI & Software company, is valued at $5.6B post-money following $600M+ in total funding. The peer universe comprises 9 comparable entities—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private—including Stage B competitors Scale AI ($29.0B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), and Field AI ($2.0B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $5.6B last post-money valuation and applying a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies $10.6B. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $3.2B, with a wide range from $2.0B to $29.0B reflecting heterogeneity in the Series B AI cohort. The peer set demonstrates substantial valuation dispersion, suggesting differentiation factors beyond stage and sector.

Triangulation of these two methods produces a valuation range of $2.8B (low) to $12.2B (high), with a median of $6.9B. The current $5.6B valuation sits within this range but below the midpoint, indicating modest discount to the triangulated median. Key uncertainties include the sustainability of Series B multiples in frontier AI given market volatility, and significant heterogeneity in peer valuations that limits peer-median precision. Revenue generation, IP defensibility, and capital efficiency differentials among comparables are critical but unobserved factors driving the wide peer range.
